answer: A milestone bond blocks bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits and files three milestones on a horizon table. Each date the agent lights one ember proof, a key-signed receipt a falcon auditor replays on the horizon table. A missing, copied, or late ember proof burns the bond; shared receipts burn every sharer. Filings start at 40, climbing 6 per slot: 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked, chasing a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 40.
